_comment: The FROZEN parameters and nothing else — PROTOCOL.md §4. Fill in, rename to protocol.json, commit and git-tag it. Operational settings (drand endpoint, Pantheon base URLs, timeouts) belong in runtime.json and are deliberately not frozen; putting one of them here is rejected at startup. chain_hash and chain_public_key are the real drand quicknet values as of 2026-09-09, verified against https://api.drand.sh/<chain_hash>/info — re-confirm both at freeze time. Use tools/pick-round.js --in 72h --write to set target_round and submission_cutoff_utc together, so they cannot disagree.
